\title{A Paper With an Abstract}
\author{AViD Test Fixture}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
We study the properties of even numbers and their sums.
In particular, we show that the sum of any two even natural numbers
is again an even natural number. This result generalizes to
finite sums of arbitrary length.
\end{abstract}

\begin{theorem}[Sum of evens]
If $a$ and $b$ are even natural numbers, then $a + b$ is even.
\end{theorem}
